document.name: Shaft locating collar
document.description: A round stainless steel collar with a through bore for a 16 mm shaft, clamped by a single radial set screw at the axial midpoint.

requirements.statement: The collar's outer diameter is 30 mm, giving an overall X extent of 30 mm.
The collar's outer diameter is 30 mm, giving an overall Y extent of 30 mm.
The collar is 12 mm long along its axis, giving an overall Z extent of 12 mm.
The collar's outer diameter shall be 30 mm.
The collar shall be 12 mm long.
The through bore shall be 16 mm in diameter, running the full length of the collar.
requirements.rationale: Stated directly in the brief; bore is a feature dimension, not an overall extent.

requirements.statement: The set screw hole shall be 5 mm in diameter, passing radially through the wall into the bore.
The collar shall have exactly one set screw hole.
requirements.rationale: Brief specifies a single set screw hole.

requirements.statement: The part shall be round about its axis.
requirements.rationale: The brief gives this part's size as a diameter, or calls it round.

requirements.statement: The part shall have 1 open hole of 16 mm down the part's axis.
requirements.rationale: The brief sizes and counts these holes.

requirements.statement: The part shall have 1 open hole of 5 mm.
requirements.rationale: The brief sizes and counts these holes.

assumptions.statement: The set screw hole is centered at the axial midpoint of the collar (6 mm from each end), oriented radially (perpendicular to the bore axis).
assumptions.rationale: Brief states the hole is 'halfway along the length.'
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: Minor relocation would only affect cosmetic/assembly convenience, not function.

assumptions.statement: The stainless steel grade is a common general-purpose grade (e.g., 303 or 304 stainless), chosen for machinability and corrosion resistance, in the absence of a specified grade.
assumptions.rationale: Brief states 'stainless steel' without a grade.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If a specific grade (e.g., 316 for marine/chemical exposure, or 17-4PH for higher strength) is actually required, corrosion resistance or strength could be inadequate for the real application.

assumptions.statement: The 16 mm bore is sized as a nominal clearance fit intended to receive a 16 mm shaft, with no specific tolerance class (e.g., H7) called out.
assumptions.rationale: Shaft collars by definition mate with a shaft of matching nominal diameter; brief gives only the nominal bore size.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If a tighter fit or specific tolerance class is actually required for proper clamping/locating, the as-built bore could be too loose or too tight for the shaft.

assumptions.statement: The 5 mm set screw hole is modeled as a plain 5 mm diameter through hole (clearance/tap drill size) without a specified thread callout (e.g., M5x0.8).
assumptions.rationale: Brief gives only a diameter for the set screw hole, not a thread specification.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If a tapped thread of a specific pitch is required for the set screw to actually function, the hole as modeled would not accept a standard set screw.
